digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync command and reconciler request routing
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass, emit a single manifest containing arbitrated plan entries plus exact field-level drift from that same pass, and load active tickets only once without invoking or duplicating reconcile-check.
Canonical preview must remain lock-free: it acquires, purges, steals, and writes no pass lock, leaving all collateral repository/ref/binding/snapshot/diagnostic/lock state byte-identical.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains all existing behavior: all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, bridge_state/reconcile-check.json artifact, and exit semantics unchanged.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit identical field-comparable manifest envelopes; canonical uncapped sync must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally; legacy uncapped LIVE (CLI, library, MCP, workflows) must retain historical tally-only/no-retained-manifest behavior.

Parser must set allow_abbrev=False: abbreviated or unknown options must exit 2 before any repository/lock reads or mutations, while all documented legacy options (--mode dry-run, --mode reconcile-check, --mode live) remain valid.

Documentation must explicitly specify bridge preview as canonical dry-run guidance, document reconcile-check as distinct lock-free diagnostic, preserve legacy uncapped LIVE output continuity, and map production workflows (dry-run→preview, live→sync, reconcile-check→reconcile --mode reconcile-check).
